beats.name: hook
beats.said: A man was buried alive with a bell tied to his finger.
beats.shown: Two men at grave edge, then drop into grave and coffin, string up to bell post.

beats.name: explainer
beats.said: People feared waking in coffins, so graves had a bell connected by string to the finger.
beats.shown: Bell post, cutaway of buried man with string running up through soil.

beats.name: setup
beats.said: Bell rings at 2am; neighbour blames wind; it speeds up and the street comes out.
beats.shown: Snowy night bell, sleeper in bed, street, porch neighbours.

beats.name: escalation
beats.said: Neighbours argue who checks; doctor is fetched and insists the man is dead; wife not outside.
beats.shown: Porch dialogue, doctor in lantern light with certificate, dark house.

beats.name: twist
beats.said: Wife waits with shovel, recognises the practised signal; he was never dead.
beats.shown: Wife in dark room, bell and signal note on wall, man grinning in coffin.

beats.name: payoff
beats.said: He faked death over debts; she was meant to dig him up, but sits listening all night.
beats.shown: Pile of debt notices, creditor queue, certificate, garden, wife in rocking chair.

beats.name: ending
beats.said: Debts buried with him, house all hers.
beats.shown: Wife in snow shovelling a mound, small smile at the end.

hook.first_frame: Two characters stand at a fresh grave in orange dusk: ginger man in black suit and a man in a brown hat; bell post behind.
hook.first_3s: Fast push-in and crane-down into the grave and coffin, ginger man lying inside with sly grin, then up the string to a bell post.
hook.title_vs_first_line: Title promises a hidden meaning of the bell; first line states the burial with a bell and leaves the meaning open.

story.real_fact_core: Safety coffins with bells existed; here a staged death clears a man's debts and the signal tells the wife the truth.
story.protagonist: Wife of the buried man (S. Holt), who sits in the dark with a shovel.
story.authority_or_antagonist: Neighbours, the doctor who signed the certificate, and the creditors.
story.explainer_turn: You see (3.16s), and again You see (54.02s)
story.ending_type: twist reveal is the last line

tone.humour: Dry dark comedy: neighbours dodge checking, wife calmly lets the husband stay buried.
tone.deadpan_or_irony: Flat voice, wife's half-lidded stare, and a smug victory smile at the end.
tone.dialogue_style: Short quoted lines inside narration, no distinct character voices (estimate from transcript).
